exposure: serum creatinine to body weight ratio (CBWR) in late pregnancy
cohort: The study included 11,734 pregnant Chinese women with hospital-based hepatic/renal data from 2016-2017.
finding: Elevated maternal serum creatinine to body weight ratio (CBWR) in late pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of small for gestational age (SGA) and a decreased risk of large for gestational age (LGA) newborns.
